reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I really don't like swallowing pills, and this is 2 capsules every single day. The lab report and the guarantee are nice, but it's still pills.
objection: Two capsules to swallow every day. I'd stop after a week and the rest of the box would sit in a drawer.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or a drink-mix version with the same tested dose.
